I set up my oppe vm yesterday and today it shows this message. Is this normal ? If its not then please tell me what to do. Will i be able to access it an hour before exam or what is it? I am confused. Please guide asap @21f3000759

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Don’t panic. You can simply do

ssh-keygen -R se2001-oppe-room2.study.iitm.ac.in

You will be able to login at 5 pm not now.

If you get permission denied do this →

Permission Denied in Course vm login System Commands
No, you shouldn’t again & again do ssh-keygen. Just do cd .ssh ls there you will see either id_ed25519.pub or id_rsa.pub based on the file you see do - cat id_ed25519.pub or cat id_rsa.pub then copy (but don’t use notepad.exe it copies extra characters → directly copy from terminal) Paste it to both course vm portal and oppe portal. You will not be able to access oppe vm now, it will open at 5 pm.
